# Tasks & Design Notes: Zenith (`bootstrap-buttons-05`)

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib **Bootstrap Buttons 05** (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-05/`) under the name **Zenith**.

## Section Order & Architecture

1. **Header / Navbar**: Brand logo ("Zenith"), navigation links (Styles, Shapes, Playground, Docs), and GitHub/ComponentDock CTA.
2. **Hero Section**: Bold headline introducing the comprehensive button component library, description, and primary CTA buttons.
3. **Solid & Semantic Variants**: Primary, Secondary, Success, Danger, Warning, and Info solid buttons with hover states.
4. **Outline & Ghost Variants**: Clean bordered buttons and transparent ghost buttons.
5. **Shapes & Sizes**: Pill (`rounded-full`), rounded (`rounded-lg`), square (`rounded-none`), small/medium/large sizes.
6. **Interactive Playground**: Live configuration widget where users can customize props and copy Tailwind JSX code.
7. **Footer**: Component attribution linking `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock"), copyright, and quick links.

## Design Fidelity Notes

- **Colors**: Indigo primary palette (`#4f46e5`), slate neutrals (`#f8fafc`, `#64748b`).
- **Typography**: Inter font with clear weight hierarchy.
- **Interactivity**: Smooth hover transitions, active click states, and a fully interactive playground for exploring button variations.
